title: Gemma Scope Release
summary: Google DeepMind announced Gemma Scope on July 31, 2024 as an open suite of sparse autoencoders for language-model interpretability, providing hundreds of freely available sparse autoencoders for Gemma 2 9B and 2B.
significance: A dated release milestone for an open interpretability toolset built for layer-level study of Gemma 2 models.

verification.note: Google DeepMind's dated announcement directly states that on July 31, 2024 it was announcing Gemma Scope and describes it as hundreds of freely available open sparse autoencoders for Gemma 2 9B and 2B. The current official Gemma Scope product page independently describes Gemma Scope as interpretability tools for Gemma models and says the original Gemma Scope enables layer-level analysis of Gemma 2. No development geography, ancestry, influence, causality, universal priority, or unsupported relationship edge is inferred.
